I answered Hollis in a reply to his message in #central-random: the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging is ticket **#88412**.

That comes from #central-team, a channel Hollis is in. Tobias raised it there as a Tier 2 escalation on July 2, 2025. The tablet's scanner hung while reading the bill-of-lading barcode whenever a Quarendon Freightways driver arrived with a split manifest. In the same thread Tobias first called the account "TP," then corrected it to Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.
